notes:
Chat media recovery and clear errors. The photo chooser now keeps its pending callback when Android resumes the app before returning the selected file. An empty picker result gives a visible message. Blank photo types can be checked by decoding the image; unsupported photos show a clear decode error.

Microphone permission has a bounded request window. The app waits for Android permission, native unlock, foreground and web readiness before granting microphone access. Timeout, screen-off and denial still preserve the lock and permission rules.

Failed photo uploads, voice uploads and message sends now show fixed on-screen codes and Retry, without private server details or file paths. APK 2.1 Back behavior, screenshot protection and Friend mode remain.

These changes address known lifecycle races. Physical Android gallery/microphone behavior could not be verified, so they are not a guarantee that every device-specific media issue is resolved. Update over the existing app; do not uninstall.
